 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA  ORDER % 16.02.2023 1.

Petitioner files this petition for quashing of the FIR No.534/2019 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Mangolpuri, Delhi against him and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between the petitioner and complainant/ respondent No.2 was solemnized on 28.12.2018 according to Sikh rites and ceremonies at Delhi.

However, due to matrimonial discord,
the couple is residing separately since 30.12.2018 and on the complaint of respondent No.2 aforesaid FIR was registered against the petitioner.
Various other litigations have been filed by the couple against each other.
During the pendency of proceedings, the couple settled the matter per Memorandum of Understanding/settlement agreement dated 01.06.2022.
The parties have also obtained divorce by mutual consent.

Pursuant to settlement, the petitioner agreed to pay Rs.13.00 Lacs to respondent No.2 towards all her claims of alimony, maintenance - past, present and future,
stridhan, and dowry articles etc.
The said amount has already been received by respondent No.2.

3. The complainant/respondent No.2 has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer, states the matter has been settled with the petitioner having left with no claim against him and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
The learned APP for the State has also no objection, if this petition is allowed.
The affidavits of parties are on record.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties, there is no impediment in quashing of the FIR as complainant has settled all the disputes and has received the settled amount from the Jaspal Singh Kinot vs State & Anr on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149137321/
1 petitioner.

sentences.text: In view of the above, there is no use to continue with the proceedings against petitioner as it would never entail in his conviction.
5. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, FIR No.534/2019 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Mangolpuri, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
No order as to costs.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
